ana-docs: Heads-up
I'm authoring a small PR for 'USB-mediated airgap mirror & HSM offline escrow' - single page operator playbook. Purpose: for sites that cannot use network mirrors and must transfer packages/keys via removable media.

cheng-sre: Interesting. Make sure we add LUKS encryption example for the USB mirror and a note about entropy seeding before HSM ops. Operators forget rngd and see HSM timeouts.

ana-docs: (typo) ana-docs: Good call. Plan sections: preflight (device format/verif), create encrypted mirror, verify checksums, HSM offline escrow (wrap/unwrap), restore procedure, and a tiny Go SDK snippet for offline wrap.

gita-eng: For encrypted USB example, include commands: `cryptsetup luksFormat /dev/sdb1 --key-file /root/usb.key` and `cryptsetup open --key-file /root/usb.key /dev/sdb1 mirror` then rsync. Also add how to create a detached SHA256SUMS file and verify on target.

cheng-sre: Add one-liner to seed rng on headless box: `dd if=/dev/urandom of=/dev/random bs=1 count=512` with a caution. Add udev rule for persistent device path `/dev/by-id/usb-mirror`.

ana-docs: Draft Go SDK snippet (tiny):
```go
// go: offline wrap example
client := kms.NewClient(kms.Config{Mode: "offline", Endpoint: "https://127.0.0.1:8443"})
resp, err := client.WrapKey(context.Background(), &kms.WrapParams{KeyID: "slot1", Data: []byte("secret")})
if err != nil { log.Fatalf("wrap failed: %v", err) }
fmt.Printf("wrapped blob len=%d", len(resp.Blob))
```

gita-eng: Nice. Also include a short section on chain-of-custody: sign the SHA256SUMS with GPG and show verify steps on the target host.

cheng-sre: PR note: call out risks when moving wrapped keys between different HSM models. Add a checklist item: test unwrap on staging HSM of same firmware before decommission.

pr-bot: PR opened by ana-docs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4337 a "usb-airgap-mirror-hsm-escrow". CI: docs-lint passed, linkcheck flagged one internal ops link.

ana-docs: ana-docs: I'll swap that link to private/connectivity/hsm-quickstart and add the udev + rngd cautions. Tagging @cheng-sre @gita-eng for review. :thumbsup:
